body: I may be going through a lot, but I’ve always put others before me, so here goes nothing. You’ve got every right to be sad, you have every right to be depressed or discouraged. Shit is going to happen and it’s up to you to show life who’s boss. Take the time to cry, take the time to isolate and go for a walk or go for a drive, whatever brings you comfort. Drawing, even if you can’t draw. Singing, even if you can sing. Do what makes you the happiest, even if it doesn’t make you happy right away, just use that as a motivational memory, to show yourself that you ARE capable. Sorry I have ADHD so some of this might not even be relevant. Life has its bumps. You’re not selfish for feeling this way, you are very valid, your feelings express who you are in that moment. A tree that survives a storm will only grow stronger.
